issue.title: routing-day-window: "the wide model's row was never drawn" under load (chromium ja 420px)
issue.body:
routing-day-window.test.cjs:106 failed once in a 13-file Routing GUI run at load ~240 (2026-10-22 ~12:55 UTC, tree = origin/main 802fb6e61 plus a routing.css padding change for #2553):

```
not ok 185 - chromium ja 420px: a day of 2000 requests draws the rows in sight, looking as it did with all of them
  ---
  duration_ms: 42882.521292
  type: 'test'
  location: '/Users/yetone/workspace/projects/magpie-wt/rt-dot-2553/internal/gui/tests/routing-day-window.test.cjs:106:7'
  failureType: 'testCodeFailure'
  error: "the wide model's row was never drawn"
  code: 'ERR_ASSERTION'
  name: 'AssertionError'
  expected: true
  actual: false
  operator: '=='
  stack: |-
    TestContext.<anonymous> (/Users/yetone/workspace/projects/magpie-wt/rt-dot-2553/internal/gui/tests/routing-day-window.test.cjs:151:9)
    async Test.run (node:internal/test_runner/test:1054:7)
    async Test.processPendingSubtests (node:internal/test_runner/test:744:7)
  ...
# Subtest: chromium de 1280px: a day of 2000 requests draws the rows in sight, looking as it did with all of them
ok 186 - chromium de 1280px: a day of 2000 requests draws the rows in sight, looking as it did with all of them
  ---
  duration_ms: 14262.886833
  type: 'test'
  ...
```

Run alone afterwards, routing-day-window + routing-flood passed 42/42 twice with the #2553 change and 42/42 with the old CSS, so it fails only under load. The test probably waits a fixed time for the virtualised list to draw the wide model's row; it should wait for the row (the state) instead. Not taken by me yet.

comments.body:
Fixed on a fork branch: `fix/3278-day-window-budget` (head `1386690f`, on upstream `6eb510f7`) — the day-window test's scroll is bounded by the list it walks.

**Root cause.** `internal/gui/tests/routing-day-window.test.cjs`'s scroll loop had a fixed 60-iteration budget while the list is virtual with `heights.get(id) ?? est` (`routing/client.js`, `est = winAvg || 31`): at 420px with 3-line rows a 2000-row list is ~120,000px tall while a stale estimate says ~62,000px, so the wide model at ~85% of the real height is far past `0.8·H_est + 60·420` — the budget, not the waiting, is what failed under load.

**Change.** the loop is bounded by the list itself (`i < 400 && at.top + at.view < at.height - 2`), so a genuinely stuck list now fails honestly at the assertion instead of exhausting an arbitrary budget; the final assertion is as it was. The other `routing-*.test.cjs` files that copy the idiom walk lists small enough not to need it and are untouched.

**Verified.** Red: `the same file with `.rt-req{min-height:66px}` injected after `pickDay(1,16)` (the mixed drawn/estimated state load produced), old budget` → `routing-day-window.test.cjs:152: the wide model's row was never drawn` (chromium and webkit, ja 420)
Green: `the height-bounded loop with the style tag removed → 30/30 (both engines × en/zh/ja/de × 420/1100)` → `ℹ pass 30, fail 0`

Full `go test -tags nogui ./...` over round 27's branches: 70 packages ok, 5 red (edit `TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink`, gateway's five, plugin `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`, provider's synctest fatal in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`, testenv `TestProgram`) — every one of them reproduces identically at base `6eb510f7` in this environment (umask 0027), so none is from this change.

Branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3278-day-window-budget — no PR opened, this repo takes no external PRs; say the word if you'd rather have the patch inline here.
